checks: Warm authentication reads one current identity row instead of every account
A cold schema verifies existing headers without rewriting them
Stale, foreign and out-of-bounds row hints cannot select another account
Name, disabled status, role and credentials are always read from the live row
Cache read/write failures preserve authentication and no missing identity is cached
A row move between the narrow index scan and identity read uses a fresh atomic fallback
Login hints validate current spelling, group, password salt and row position
Missing and damaged private headers are repaired, with explicit maintenance still available
Unchanged account polls do not re-encrypt and rewrite the local profile
A changed remote document is applied and durably saved
A local change cannot be posted before its request ID is durably saved
An unchanged poll retries an earlier failed save of applied remote data
An unstable cursor is persisted and forces a later retry
An immediate save supersedes the pending autosave without a duplicate write
Question two renders while a 1200 ms profile write is pending
Rapid navigation and newer answers are durably saved after the delayed write
A disk failure remains visible and retry preserves both answers
Restart restores every selected answer without application errors
Authenticated attempt traffic pauses publication before it takes the shared lock
Waiting signed requests announce priority while forged requests cannot pause publication
One finishing snapshot plus the result commit replace a redundant completed-state rewrite
Lost finish acknowledgement and a new session resolve to the same accepted result
Repeated checkpoints never delete rows; idle batches retain the latest three exact snapshots
A partially acknowledged maintenance batch resumes using current row positions
Either failed durable flush refuses acknowledgement; replay keeps one result and all answers
A Google service failure during authentication remains retryable and leaves the valid session usable
Signing reads its current secret once per mutation, then drops the request cache
Busy delivery retries stay staggered and bounded while offline backoff remains exponential
Classroom sign-in survives ten capacity refusals but limits offline and service-error retries
Cloud checkpoints coalesce for a minute while explicit save and finish send the latest local answer immediately
Publication repairs only the matching details within a large unrelated history
Ordinary idle instructor refreshes finish bounded maintenance after the publication queue is empty
Leading plus signs remain literal in both credential cells and issued tokens stay valid
The real password derivation signs in using a salt beginning with plus
Password reset uses literal encoding, revokes old sessions and preserves the vault key and account ID
Unprefixed legacy credentials and their existing session remain compatible
Recoverable legacy formulas restore exact bytes without replacing the account or invalidating its session
Recovery yields when the lock is busy and never uses a shifted account row
Recovery does not release a lock already held by its caller
Unrecoverable values remain untouched and a malformed challenge produces a Ukrainian error
A transient missing signing-key read cannot replace the existing key or invalidate the account
A missing established signing key fails without regenerating it or changing accounts and vault keys

checks.name: Capacity and network streaks reset independently while consecutive outages retain bounded exponential backoff
Recorded BUSY x4 then 90-second lost acknowledgement recovers inside the unchanged 240-second budget
A persisted result queue with many capacity failures gives a new network error its first delay without changing answers
Actual exam background resets the network retry delay after capacity refusals and resets again after success
A health response before start is rejected then retried with the exact original request ID
A committed start with an unrelated acknowledgement resumes one original attempt with its fixed deadline
A committed save followed by a health response retries identical answers and does not create an extra revision
A committed finish with a health response confirms one result using the frozen final request
Persistent missing envelopes stop bounded retries and keep the disk finish intent until a valid acknowledgement
A reply for another account remains a nonretryable validation error and cannot unlock the exam
Unrelated discovery responses cannot erase an active local answer or acknowledge its pending checkpoint
Switching accounts during a retry pause prevents sending another request with the previous session
Health and missing synchronization protocols cannot acknowledge an API operation while a legitimate empty success remains valid
The real application relay retries a read with the identical envelope and never exposes the health reply
A committed account checkpoint with an unrelated acknowledgement replays its original ID and creates one revision
An unknown acknowledgement after non-idempotent creation is not automatically repeated
A missing envelope after four capacity refusals receives its own bounded retry allowance
The unchanged 240-second budget retains a final useful retry instead of aborting with unused time
Redirected load requests share the 90-second operation budget and use the native 45-second receive timeout
